scope: Public source discovery; no source binaries, private credential, new compute or promotion. No personnel identities retained.

observations.finding: Public index associates exact Gazette identifier with naval honorary commission notification, not an Army Rules amendment.
Exact identifier indexed against a naval honorary commission instrument, not an Army Rules amendment.
Indexed notification identifies its enabling provision as Rule 33 of Territorial Army Rules, 1948; not the Army Rules, 1954. Retain only statutory subject classification, not operational content.

Public indexes link the identifier to honorary commission/personnel notices, not an identified Army Rules amendment. Issue may contain multiple instruments; do not retain individual personnel details.
Exact file/identifier searches returned no reliable identity match. Direct locator inaccessible in browser. No negative claim.

Official parliamentary index, printed p53, records bill introduction (Vol III col 4959), consideration and passing (Vol IV cols 6040–44), Rajya Sabha agreement without amendment (Vol IV col 6677), assent (Vol V col 8284). Parliamentary provenance locator only; not enacted Schedule or commencement notification.

Central Secretariat Library identifies digitized Gazette collection 1950–2002 and refers to Department of Publication search. Custodian route for unresolved originals including 1955 Schedule and historical Army Rules notifications; no claim exact instrument located.

Punjab and Haryana High Court Rules and Orders Vol III Chapter 6 Part C reproduces 1978 adjustment-of-jurisdiction rules; p2 correction-slip reference 69/22 dated 15 September 1978. This is a court-hosted compilation, not original Gazette or proof of 1986 amendment incorporation. Two page screenshots timed out.

Judgment reproduction R.K. Yadav v State (20 June 2007) identifies MHA S.O. 488 dated 9 February 1978, Gazette Part II section (ii), 25 February 1978. Original notification and 1986 amendment remain outstanding.

Official DESW directory lists Army Pension Regulations 2008 Parts I and II and combined 2023 Entitlement Rules/Guide to Medical Officers. Link directory, not evidence of exact source bytes or amendment completeness.

Official DESW publication entry gives 21 September 2023 issue date for the 2023 entitlement/medical guide release. Effective dates, transitional provisions and historical amendments require instrument review; no PDF acquired.
Official circular index provides a route to amending pension orders. No exhaustive circular coverage or authorization of a broad DESW host scope.
